## Summary

- What user-visible behavior changed?
- Why is the change needed?

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] I tested any live behavior separately from deterministic tests.
- [ ] I documented public Threads availability, rate-limit, or login-wall changes.

## Distribution and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private exports, databases, generated research,
      screenshots, or personal filesystem paths are included.
- [ ] The change stays within the public, read-only product boundary.
